topic: How does TDD satellite system design account for large RTT when optimizing antenna gain and coverage for delay-sensitive RLNC applications?
consensus_response: TDD satellite system design accounts for large RTT by balancing the trade-offs between antenna gain, coverage, and system performance. Advanced signal processing techniques, machine learning, and dynamic optimization can improve the efficiency and reliability of transmission. Dynamic resource allocation, adaptive modulation and coding, and edge computing can help manage the impact of large RTT on system performance. Accurate propagation modeling and validation using a combination of field measurements, simulation-based validation, and machine learning techniques are essential for reliable transmission. Reinforcement learning and deep learning can be employed for real-time optimization of TDD satellite systems.
reference_context: The importance of considering propagation delay and feedback in TDD satellite systems was discussed. The use of massive MIMO and precoding techniques was also mentioned, highlighting their limitations in satellite communications due to propagation delay and interference. The development of more efficient and reliable TDD satellite systems requires careful consideration of these factors.
